cohort: 165 pregnant women with COVID-19 and 11 neonates with early-onset SARS-CoV-2 infection
finding: Severe COVID-19 disease during pregnancy was associated with high rates of intrauterine fetal demise and maternal mortality, while early-onset neonatal SARS-CoV-2 infection was mostly asymptomatic and had a good prognosis.
birth_weight: 2,551.81 grams (average for neonates with early-onset SARS-CoV-2 infection)
